type Getter = { get x(): number };
type Field = { x: number };
const v: Getter & Field = { x: 1 };
v.x = 2;
const w: { get value(): string } & { value: string } & { tag: number } = { value: "a", tag: 1 };
w.value = "b";
class Box {
  #size = 1;
  get size(): number {
    return this.#size;
  }
  set size(value: number | string) {
    this.#size = Number(value);
  }
}
const box: Box & { size: number } = Object.assign(new Box(), { size: 2 });
box.size = 3;
console.log(v.x, w.value, box.size);
